requirements.summary: Configurable API, independent worker, PostgreSQL, private bytes and external channels are design-only foundations.
requirements.remainingWork: A separately authorized C4a task must select exact templates, implement fixed contracts, compile and verify every foundation. No application runtime, provider provisioning, generated build or benchmark pass is supplied.

requirements.summary: SQL background work is one high-level logical channel reference; named source subchannels retain distinct payloads, claims, receipts and recovery.
requirements.remainingWork: Future C4a must preserve named source channels and SQL authority. The queue symbol does not add a broker, promise atomic external effects or provide exactly-once delivery. Queue retention remains unspecified and separate from source receipt/business retention.

requirements.summary: No cache, Redis, dedicated search cluster or new Billing deployment is introduced by this benchmark foundation.
requirements.remainingWork: Preserve current-authority reads and PostgreSQL projection/search from the source. Any separately requested cache must prove freshness, invalidation and revocation; no cache is required or selected by this source. Vendure payment policy stays inside its modular API.
